ينتدبون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَدِبُونَ (yantadibūna) /jan.ta.di.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# يُنْتَدَبُونَ (yuntadabūna) /jun.ta.da.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
